description: E1 minimal run: A5 (training-data size), A6 (parameter distribution), A13 (range-clipped oracle). Baseline=B01 (V route, huber, m12-style MLP, fixed n=10).

training_pool.description: Deterministic Sobol pool; rows allocated as nested prefixes (7K/25K/100K/400K) for A5.

validation.note: Lean-route correction: 128 pts x 20 reps = 2560 rows. Intentional reduction from formal-era 256x50; records this as a preregistered lean choice, not a result-driven reduction. Cluster bootstrap over parameter points.

confirmation.note: Lean-route correction: 64 pts x 20 reps = 1280 rows. Intentional reduction from formal-era overkill; preregistered before execution. Used ONCE after model/analysis choices frozen. Compares preregistered experiment arms. Does NOT tune architecture, loss, thresholds, or exclusions.

A13_oracle.description: Range-clipped traditional oracle: clip(β_hat, 1.2, 4.0), clip(η_hat, 100, 10000), ρ_c = clip(γ_hat/η_hat, 0, 1), γ_c = ρ_c * η_c. Original failures remain failures.

metrics.primary: L_param (composite RMSE of normalized errors e_beta, e_eta, e_gamma)
metrics.multiple_comparison_note: Primary decisions use effect sizes + cluster CIs (bootstrap over parameter points). No p-value family correction is emitted; Holm correction would be applied if p-value families were reported.

stop.note: 21 fits = A5(12) + A6(9). A13 reuses existing conventional methods, adds no NN fits. Pilot uses single-size/single-dist with 1 seed.
